name: team_planning_pin_change
description: Pin what a scenario of a Team Planning plan inherits for one facet of one subject, as it resolves now, so a later change in its parent no longer reaches it: the 'keep the plan' answer when reconciling. facet is as team_planning_overrides lists it, such as 'rule:<name>'. The pin records where the value came from. Refused for the baseline, for a facet the scenario already changes, in a plan scoped to chosen units for someone, a unit or a position the plan no longer covers, or unless the caller is an editor. `note` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.

note.description: Why this is in the plan, such as the business reason for a move. Optional, at most 2000 characters; it never changes what the scenario resolves to. A note on a change to a person goes when they are forgotten. Any other note, such as one on a unit, a position or a rule, stays until the plan is deleted, so keep personal details out of it.
